title: Crashes with nonexistent image paths in prompt
body: ### What version of Codex is running? 0.1.2504172351 ### Which model were you using? default ### What platform is your computer? ubuntu 20 ### What steps can reproduce the bug? install codex on ubuntu 20 Enter as first prompt: `doesnotexist.png` Crash. Discovered when trying to describe a file name in another directory. ### What is the expected behavior? It should not crash when I enter an image filepath that doesn't exist, so I can describe filenames. ### What do you see instead? ### Additional information _No response_

linked_prs.title: fix alignment in slash command popup

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue involves prompt management problems, as the system crashes when handling a nonexistent image path in a prompt, indicating a failure in handling unexpected prompt inputs, which aligns with prompt-related issues in agent systems.
